results.title: General Manager – Land Transportation
results.description: Our client, a growing land transportation company based in Najran, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven General Manager to lead the business through its next stage of growth. The role requires a business builder with a strong track record of growing and scaling transportation or logistics businesses. The successful candidate will have full responsibility for the company's strategic, commercial, operational, and financial performance, with a strong mandate to accelerate business development, market penetration, expansion, and modernization . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a multi-year growth and expansion strategy to significantly strengthen the company's market position. Drive business development and market penetration through new customers, contracts, sectors, services, and strategic partnerships. Identify and evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, service diversification, and fleet investment. Take full ownership of the company's P&L, revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and overall business performance. Lead large-scale transportation and fleet operations, ensuring strong asset utilization, productivity, service reliability, and cost efficiency. Optimize fleet performance, maintenance, fuel consumption, route planning, capacity utilization, and operational KPIs. Lead commercial negotiations, contract pricing, customer management, and strategic account development. Drive the company's digitalization and modernization agenda , leveraging technology, data, automation, and modern transport/fleet management systems. Build scalable organizational structures, processes, systems, and capabilities to support rapid business growth. Build and develop a strong leadership team and establish a performance-driven, accountable organizational culture. Maintain strong relationships with customers, strategic partners, government entities, and other key stakeholders. Ensure appropriate governance, safety, risk management, and regulatory compliance as the organization expands. Candidate Profile Minimum 12 years of relevant experience , including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity . Strong background within land transportation, logistics, fleet management, or a closely related sector . Proven track record of growing, scaling, or significantly expanding a business , with tangible achievements in revenue growth, market penetration, new customer acquisition, or business expansion. Strong business development and commercial orientation combined with solid transportation and fleet operational expertise. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong understanding of profitability, cost structures, investment decisions, and asset utilization. Experience leading sizeable operational workforces and multidisciplinary teams. Exposure to digital transformation, fleet technology, automation, or transportation management systems is highly desirable. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and highly results-oriented leadership style. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred. Interested candidates with a demonstrated record of building and scaling transportation businesses are invited to apply or share their profile for confidential consideration.

results.title: Senior Director: Mobility Planner
results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 25+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical command over macro and micro traffic simulation modeling software (e.g., PTV VISSIM, VISUM, Synchro, or equivalent platforms). Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to present complex multi-modal transit strategies and traffic data to fin

results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Logistics & Fleet Analyst
results.description: Job Summary We are looking for a Logistics & Fleet Analyst to support our day-to-day transportation, fleet, driver, Sales invoices, and logistics operations. The role will be responsible for monitoring fleet performance, coordinating trucks and drivers, analyzing logistics costs, Sales invoices , maintaining accurate records, and supporting efficient delivery operations. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily Sales Invoices / truck and driver allocation based on delivery requirements. Monitor truck utilization, delivery schedules, routes, and vehicle availability. Coordinate with Warehouse, Sales, and Logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries. Monitor driver attendance, trips, working hours, and performance. Maintain accurate fleet, driver, vehicle, and delivery records. Track fuel consumption, maintenance, repair costs, and other fleet-related expenses. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly fleet and logistics performance reports. Analyze transportation costs and identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvement. Monitor delivery performance, including delays, trip completion, and POD status. Support the preparation and processing of sales invoices and delivery-related documents, where required. Work closely with external transporters and service providers when required. Develop and maintain Excel-based trackers and dashboards for fleet and logistics KPIs. Support management with logistics data analysis, forecasting, and operational reports. Ensure compliance with company policies, safety requirements, and local transportation regulations. Qualifications & Requirements Minimum 3 years relevant experience in Kuwait / GCC Logistics, Fleet Management, Transportation Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, and data analysis. Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, fleet management systems, or other logistics software. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to prepare and interpret logistics and fleet performance reports.. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple operational priorities. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.

results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: Manager, Micro Mobility Operations
results.description: Redefining Land, Air, and Sea Travel… Elevating Destinations. Coastal Transportation Services Co., a Red Sea Global Subsidiary Coastal Transportation Services Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, provides Transportation services at our Red Sea destination and is part of the Red Sea Global Group of companies. We specialize in providing transportation services to our Red Sea destination. As a subsidiary, Coastal Transportation Services Co. benefits from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives within the Red Sea Global group of companies, enhancing our ability to serve our clients effectively. Are you ready to transform the future of transportation? At Coastal Transportation Services Co., we are driven by innovation, creativity, and a passion for redefining transportation. Our team is shaping the future with cutting-edge projects, from autonomous vehicles to sustainable transportation solutions. We are seeking forward-thinking individuals eager to collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where ideas become reality. Join us in revolutionizing transportation and creating a smarter, more sustainable world—one innovation at a time. Join our visionary team and help shape the future of transportation! Job Purpose: To lead the operational planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of micro mobility services across the organization’s properties. This role is responsible for ensuring seamless delivery of buggy, e-bike, and other micro mobility solutions, supporting the wider Mobility strategy. The position holds accountability for service delivery, stakeholder engagement, team leadership and operational efficiency in a 24/7 environment. Key Responsibilities: Service Operations Leadership Manage daily micro mobility operations across multiple service types and locations. Ensure service continuity, timely asset availability and operational resilience. Support integration of new modes (e.g., e-bikes, scooters) as part of service expansion. Team and Resource Management Lead supervisory staff, operators, and support teams across the micro mobility network. Set clear expectations and performance standards aligned with safety and customer service. Oversee training, onboarding, and staff scheduling to meet service requirements. Performance and Compliance Oversight Ensure all services operate within regulatory, safety and policy frameworks. Monitor service metrics and deliver improvement plans to enhance efficiency and user satisfaction. Implement incident management protocols and ensure timely resolution of issues. Work cross-functionally with departments including Land Operations, TOCC, Maintenance and Projects. Liaise with vendors and partners to support service delivery and infrastructure readiness. Drive forward innovation and technology adoption within micro mobility operations. Assist in the development of SOPs, risk assessments and operational documentation. Reporting and Communication Provide regular operational updates, service performance reports and improvement proposals. Ensure consistent communication across teams and with leadership. Profile Requirements Experience in operations or transport leadership, preferably within micro mobility or fleet services. Proven ability to manage teams in fast-paced, high-visibility environments. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and resolve challenges quickly. Operational mindset with the ability to lead services at both strategic and frontline levels. Adaptable and resourceful, with a commitment to service excellence.

results.title: Head of Logistics Assets (Leasing, Development, & Asset Management)

results.title: Manager Logistics Performance
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Role Summary This role owns the commercial and performance engine behind talabat UAE's operations. You'll be the person who understands how the business actually ticks, where margin is made or lost, which levers move the numbers, and what trade-offs leadership is really weighing. You'll own the operational commercials and KPI performance, drive the optimization work that improves efficiency and experience, and turn analysis into decisions. It's a role for someone equally comfortable in a model and in a room full of directors, someone who can read the data and stand their ground on what it means . What's on your plate? Commercial & P&L Ownership for Operations Own the commercials behind UAE operations, cost-per-order, rider cost, and the efficiency metrics that drive the operational P&L. Track budget vs. actuals, protect riders and 3pls earnings, and give leadership clear, data-backed trade-offs between cost, growth, and customer experience. You're the person who can explain why the numbers moved, not just that they did. Performance Management Own the UAE operational KPI stack, from forecast to actuals. Anticipate performance gaps before they hit the P&L and drive the interventions that close them. Run the reporting and executive reviews that keep leadership decision-ready. Operational Optimization Drive the optimization agenda across the network: rider economics and staffing efficiency, vendor and coverage performance, area-level improvements. Find where the operation leaks cost or time, size the opportunity, and lead the fix, balancing efficiency against rider earnings and customer experience. Data, Modeling & Insight Be genuinely good with data, able to interrogate complex models, understand what's driving them, and pressure-test assumptions rather than take outputs at face value. Build the analyses and dashboards that make decisions faster, and translate complexity into a clear "so what." SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau are a strong plus; the non-negotiable is analytical judgment. Strategic Projects & Senior Stakeholder Leadership Lead cross-functional, high-impact projects that shape UAE operations. Build the business case, run the pilot, scale what works. Throughout, work directly with senior leadership, and hold your own with directors and VPs, defending a recommendation with evidence and staying credible under challenge. What you own vs. influence: You own the operational commercials, the performance KPI stack, and the delivery of your optimization projects. You influence the ops, commercial, and product teams whose execution moves those numbers, through insight, credibility, and stakeholder trust rather than direct authority. Qualifications What did we order? At least 4 years in operations, commercial, strategy, or consulting, ideally in a marketplace, logistics, or Q-commerce environment. Commercial instinct: you understand how a business makes money and which levers actually move it. Strong data literacy, comfortable working with complex data and models, interrogating assumptions, and drawing the right conclusion. You don't need to be handed the answer. Executive presence: able to engage, challenge, and stand your ground with senior stakeholders including directors and VPs. Financial modeling and P&L fluency, you can read a model, break it, and explain it. SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau a strong plus, not a requirement. Bias for ownership and follow-through, you close the loop rather than hand off the problem. Readiness to grow into people leadership (1–2 reports over time).

results.title: ZAIN2433 - Inventory & Logistics Team Leader/Manager
results.description: About The Role The Inventory & Logistics Manager is responsible for leading inventory and logistics operations to ensure efficient stock management, timely shipment clearance, product availability, and seamless distribution across all sales channels. The role oversees inventory planning, logistics processes, warehouse operations, and supplier coordination while ensuring operational excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Lead inventory and logistics operations to ensure timely delivery and fulfilment of business requirements. Oversee shipment clearance, customs processes, and supplier deliveries until inventory is received and distributed. Manage inventory planning, stock replenishment, and buffer stock levels to maintain product availability. Oversee SIM cards, recharge cards, devices, and commercial/non-commercial inventory lifecycle management. Ensure effective warehouse operations, stock classification, item coding, and inventory accuracy. Manage return-to-vendor (RTV) activities, logistics coordination, and supplier returns. Monitor inventory KPIs and implement actions to improve operational efficiency and inventory performance. Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Sales, Warehouse, IT, and Logistics teams to support business objectives. Identify process improvement opportunities and lead inventory and logistics optimization initiatives. Ensure compliance with company policies, governance standards, ISMS requirements, and health & safety regulations. What We Need From You Skills Strong leadership and people management skills.
